repos_data.description: 🐋 Real-time whale trade tracker for Polymarket — get terminal alerts + Telegram notifications when smart money moves
Market-making strategy that placed #2 in Paradigm's Prediction Market Challenge. 110 iterations, 8 hours.
Python SDK for Polymarket order book data and backtesting. Tick-level L2 snapshots, billions of deltas, full book reconstruction, and a strategy backtesting engine with realistic execution.

Rust crate of validated, decimal-precise trading building blocks: price types, L2 order book, tick-to-OHLCV aggregation, hundreds of streaming indicators, position ledger, risk rules, Black-Scholes Greeks and a walk-forward backtester. On crates.io.
Microstructure order-flow metrics — Order Flow Imbalance (OFI), depth and trade imbalance. Dependency-free TypeScript.

Rust streaming primitives for real-time market data: exchange tick normalization (Binance, Coinbase, Alpaca, Polygon), WebSocket reconnect, lock-free SPSC ring buffer, OHLCV bars, order books, feed health and microstructure analytics (OFI, VPIN). On crates.io.
NASDAQ TotalView-ITCH 5.0 parser and order book: header-only C++23 core, pip install itch-book for BBO, trades, order-by-order and depth Parquet tables
A simulated stock market for testing trading strategies and AI agents. Orders move prices, any market can be forked, and every run reproduces exactly.
